annotations.title: Build a card dispute outcome table: win rate and days to close by reason code, with sources and a signed record

description: Card dispute outcome table. Send one row per card dispute case you handled: network (visa, mastercard, amex, discover, other), reason code, outcome (won, lost, withdrawn, open), days to close, and optionally your own merchant label. Get back win rate (won out of decided cases, with a 95 percent interval) and days to close (median, 90th percentile, mean) by network reason code, by reason-code family across networks and by merchant label, the meaning of each Visa, Mastercard and American Express code, a flag for groups with too few cases, and the federal clocks (Regulation E 1005.11, Regulation Z 1026.13) with the date each rule was last amended. Set check_sources true to ask the eCFR whether either rule was amended since. Free. No model, nothing stored, signed record. Up to 500 rows. This version has no pooled data: the table is built from your rows only. Use merchant labels, never card numbers, names or emails. Not legal, banking or compliance advice. Docs: https://llpro.ai/card-dispute-outcome-table-win

check_sources.description: Also read the eCFR version history of the two rules and report whether either was amended after the date this tool was written.

min_cases.description: A group with fewer decided cases than this is flagged too_few_to_rely_on. Default 20.

days_to_close.description: Days from the dispute being opened to the decision or withdrawal. Optional for open cases.

merchant.description: Your own label for the merchant or merchant account. Not a card number, name or email.

outcome.description: won = decided in the merchant's favour; lost = decided against; withdrawn = dropped by either side; open = not yet decided.

reason_code.description: As the network prints it: 10.4, 13.1, 4837, 4853, F29, C08 ... No card numbers.
